citations.cites: sub‑limit of $2,500 for business property on the residence premises

facts: Burglary resulted in theft of two laptops and a camera kit from the home office.
Insured operates a wedding photography business from the house, with gross receipts of $38,000 in the prior 12 months.
All stolen items were used for the photography business and were located at the residence at the time of loss.
Replacement cost of the stolen items is $6,000, with receipts provided.
note: The loss involves theft of business property located on the residence premises; the policy provides a $2,500 sub‑limit for such property, and no exclusion in the endorsement applies to personal property coverage for this type of loss. [HO-0509_06-24#02] [HO-0509_06-24#03]
